locations.note: Ezio's story begins in Florence, where his family is betrayed and executed.
Ezio flees with his family to his uncle Mario's villa in Monteriggioni, which becomes his base of operations.
The towers of San Gimignano are a Tuscan hunting ground for Templar targets.
Ezio helps Caterina Sforza defend the city of Forlì.
Venice's canals and rooftops host Ezio's hunt for the Templar conspirators.
The Vatican is the stage for the game's final confrontation.
Ezio climbs the Duomo's dome and campanile over Florence.
The Auditore family is hanged in front of the Palazzo Vecchio, where Ezio's story begins.
The Ponte Vecchio is one of the bridges Ezio runs across the Arno.
Santa Croce is among the Florentine churches Ezio scales.
Ezio flies Leonardo's machine over Venice and lands by St Mark's Basilica.
The Rialto Bridge carries chases across the Grand Canal.

routes.name: Ezio's revenge
routes.note: From his family's execution in Florence to the vault under the Vatican.
